rowText: Straight after the Megaera question, ask 'what about her second phase' in the same chat; the follow-up should search with the user's words and still be about Megaera.
steps: Sent the follow-up straight after the Megaera question, in the same chat.
The written reply did NOT stay on Megaera: it told the player they hadn't said which boss they meant, and gave generic second-phase advice instead of anything specific to her.
Underneath, the knowledge-base card still names 'Megaera (+2 more) - From bonsAI's own note'.

Opened Show details: Embed 28.8 ms, Re-rank 6.26 ms -- different numbers from the parent question's (539.77 ms / 3.94 ms), so a fresh search really did run for this follow-up rather than reusing the parent's.
verdictSentence: The search side did its job -- a fresh search ran for the follow-up and still found the Megaera note -- but the written reply itself talks past that and asks the player which boss they mean instead of carrying Megaera over, so from what a player reads on screen, the follow-up does not read as being about Megaera.
notes: This is a different shape of problem from the roadmap's known 'names the wrong boss one run in three' bug -- here the search stayed correct, but the wording ignored what the search found.
Same log gap as the other rows tonight: nothing in the plugin log records which note the follow-up search used, so this reading rests entirely on Show details.
